understood_as: Prepare the user's bounded history-MLP multimap study: lock policy-blind group-disjoint36/18/36 maps, validate collection/restoration, then run three normal-development seeds. Only an all-three-seed normal gate can open five new pretrains and15 adaptation branches. No generator retuning after policy results, budget extensions, replacement seeds or architecture sweep.
oracle_contract: L0 is minimum physical action count from natural delay0 start to delivery in the fixed kernel. Lcross is minimum count to delivery in mutant with at least one actual dash through an intermediate wall. Every action including pickup/delivery costs one; no inserted initial delay. Require both finite and <=48. Unchanged independent NumPy transition graph plus SciPy directed BFS is checked against real JAX kernel for every enumerated position/direction/carry/cross flag and all23 actions, and both paths replayed at waits0/12. Any verifier disagreement aborts as a technical error, never candidate rejection. See spatial_layout_panel.verify at source_sha.
identity_contract: Wall identity contains sorted floor and wall coordinates only. Acceptance identity additionally contains ordered camp/start/item roles, excluding direction; both take the lexicographically minimal canonical JSON over all D4 transforms with minimum-support-coordinate translation, then SHA256. Generator family order and RNG call order are unchanged at source_sha. Each raw candidate draw increments the50000 cap, including excluded/duplicate/quota-full draws. Frozen historical record hashes and distinct group counts are output separately.

generation.generator: unchanged spatial_layout_panel.generate_candidate; PCG64; four families round-robin
generation.assignment: SHA256 of multimap-v1: plus wall_group_sha256, modulo10:0..3 train,4..5 development,6..9 test. First eligible unique endpoint geometry per cell. No family quotas; disclose actual family/length distributions.
generation.wall_group: D4 plus translation canonicalization of complete walkable/wall masks; ignores camp/start/item/direction. All placements on the same wall group stay in one split.
generation.historical_exclusion: Conservatively exclude historical wall groups from ALL splits: original48, earlier6 transfer fixtures, and32 spatial_layout_transfer_v2 maps. Historical exact geometry hashes are also checked. This is stricter than excluding exact historical test maps; do not relax automatically.
generation.failure: If any quota cannot be filled within cap, preserve partial panel and stop before policy evaluation or training. No automatic seed change or map generator redesign.

architecture: history_mlp; unchanged actor/critic/teacher and8-token input contract from spatial_architecture_v1

normal_gate.failure: Close subsequent20 jobs; preserve all three results without extensions or curriculum.

final_evaluation.release: Only after all main learning completes. Evaluate saved5 pretrain and15 final branch policies, never use final-test scores for gating or selection.

primary: Test positive-gain maps, delay0, mode: paired q10 minus q0 joint success (fixed success AND mutant success AND mutant crossing). Also report successful exploitation=mutant success AND crossing, mutant return and regret, q10 fixed cost versus q100, and same-policy kernel return gaps. Delay12 secondary. Harmful maps separate; raw crossing is not successful exploitation.
analysis: Equal weight maps within gain cells and learner seeds; all main seeds remain even when their pretraining fails. Per-map and per-seed values mandatory. Five learner seeds, not episodes, are repetitions. Same-generator spatial generalization only.
non_claims: Panel generation feasibility is not learnability.
A90% development gate is operational, not a proof of spatial generalization.
Different episode lengths alter valid samples; collector slots and physical transitions are recorded separately.
